description: Layout, font, object and text conventions for the f_ library's .maxhelp files in package/help/: the two-column flat pane, canonical rects and varnames, the External Control Messages and References blocks, processor vs generator signal flow, the vs_wfg_s LFO wiring, and sizing the module bpatcher to its real footprint. Use this skill whenever creating, editing, fixing or reviewing an f_ helpfile, or writing the docs/f-reference/f_name.md it draws from, even if the user only says "write the help for f_name" or "the helpfile looks wrong". Load it especially when a module's UI is cropped in its helpfile, a time_s LFO does nothing, or a helpfile's text says what a module is but not what it is for. For the .maxpat JSON mechanics underneath, also use maxpat-json-authoring.
